news.headline: Central Florida Tue Nov 24: NWS Melbourne Flood Watch Wed 1 AM through Thu 1 AM and Coastal Flood Advisory Wed 5 AM through Thu 11 AM for Brevard, Treasure Coast and Okeechobee; river Flood Warnings continue on the St. Johns at Sanford (8.03 ft at 8:30 AM, forecast near 8.4 ft), Geneva, Astor, Deland and Cocoa — Melbourne Tue high near 75°F / low 67°F, Wed rain chance 60%
news.source: National Weather Service, Melbourne / Florida Today

news.headline: Florida housing Oct 2026 — Florida Realtors Nov 16: existing single-family closed sales fell 10.1% year over year to 19,049, the third straight monthly decline, while the statewide median rose 2.2% to $420,000; condo-townhouse sales fell 5% to 6,862 with median down 3.3% to $290,000, and new pending single-family sales dropped 15.7%

Orlando-area new homes Nov 2026 — Momentum tracker checked Nov 1-23 lists 24 communities in Orange, Osceola, Seminole and Lake counties, 14 selling and 10 coming soon, with listed starts from $289,990 in Howey-in-the-Hills to $813,990 in Orlando; Orange County single-family median was $501,000 in the October Stellar MLS pulse

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper falls Tue Nov 24 PM — Morningstar / Dow Jones at 1:53 PM ET: front-month COMEX copper settled 4.70% lower at $5.3625/lb, erasing Monday's Nvidia bounce as Chinese demand and U.S. rate concerns returned; a 2:43 PM quote was $5.48/lb, down 4.32%

HVAC manufacturers report increased Q3 revenue — ACHR News Nov 23: Carrier, Trane Technologies and Lennox posted improved residential and commercial revenue, data centers are driving commercial demand with Johnson Controls reporting record backlogs, and contractors face continued price increases from tariffs and high fuel prices

Wall Street opens lower Tue Nov 24 as the Nvidia-fueled AI rally fades — Reuters: Dow fell 100.7 points (0.20%) at the open to 49,494.6, S&P 500 fell 64.8 points (0.90%) to 7,172.33 and Nasdaq Composite dropped 343.7 points (1.43%) to 23,745.86, after Monday's surge

Mortgage rates Tue Nov 24 — Mortgage News Daily 30-year fixed at 7.32%, down 0.02 on the day, while Freddie Mac's weekly average was 7.28% for the week ending Nov 19; FHFA raised the 2027 conforming loan limit to $855,400 from $832,750, and markets expect a quarter-point hike at the Fed's Dec 8-9 meeting with the benchmark at 3.75%-4.00%
news.source: Mortgage News Daily / Freddie Mac / FHFA

news.headline: NBA Mon Nov 23 — Miami Heat beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113, Bam Adebayo posting a triple-double with 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists; Orlando Magic lost at the Washington Wizards 116-96; Magic (7-9) host the Detroit Pistons (10-6) Tue Nov 24 in NBA Cup play at Kia Center

NFL — all three Florida teams lost Sun Nov 22: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18; Week 12 ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM
